build_PostQuantization: build a post-training quantized model by fusing batch norm, setting backend, preparing, calibrating, and converting
build_PostQuantizationFX: build an FX graph mode quantized model by preparing with example inputs, calibrating, and converting
build_PostQuantizationGraph: build a graph mode quantized model by tracing or scripting, setting calibration, and converting with quantize_jit
run_quantize_model: run end-to-end quantization on a model builder callable with inputs, fusing batch norm and collecting stats
create_get_backend_qconfig: create a quantization config for a given backend like fbgemm, qnnpack, or qnnpack_per_channel
